cim: NEWJAK Wins CES 2027 Innovation Award in Artificial Intelligence for SPACEON, Marking 3 Straight Years of Recognition
cim_eredeti: NEWJAK Wins CES 2027 Innovation Award in Artificial Intelligence for SPACEON, Marking 3 Straight Years of Recognition
szoveg_eredeti:
– Autonomous Spatial Intelligence Platform brings NEWJAK its 4th CES Award, after X-RUNNER and SPORTRACK – NEWJAK seeks partners in North America and Europe

MAPO-GU, SEOUL, SOUTH KOREA, November 17, 2026 /EINPresswire.com/ — NEWJAK Co., Ltd. (CEO Haehyun Jung), a company specializing in spatial XR, announced that SPACEON, its Autonomous Spatial Intelligence Platform, has been named a CES Innovation Awards 2027 Honoree in the Artificial Intelligence category. The Consumer Technology Association (CTA), owner and producer of CES, announced the honorees on November 9.

NEWJAK was previously honored at CES 2025 for X-RUNNER in the Content & Entertainment and Metaverse categories, and at CES 2026 for SPORTRACK in the XR & Spatial Computing category. With SPACEON, the company has now been recognized for three consecutive years, with four CES Innovation Awards in total.

Three Straight Years in a Record Field: “The Space Itself Understands People and Responds”

Competition was tougher than ever this year. According to CTA, the 2027 program attracted close to 4,000 entries across 37 product categories, a record and 10% more than the previous year. Entries in the AI category grew 15%. NEWJAK’s platform earned its recognition as an AI technology in one of the program’s most crowded fields.

The field has grown each year NEWJAK has been honored. The entry count exceeded 3,400 when NEWJAK first won at CES 2025 and surpassed 3,600 at CES 2026. Over the same period, the categories in which NEWJAK has been recognized have widened from Content & Entertainment and Metaverse to XR & Spatial Computing, and now to Artificial Intelligence.

On the official CES website, the SPACEON listing presents the platform as a reversal of the usual arrangement, in which visitors had to adjust themselves to the content. No headset, wearable, or controller is involved, and an ordinary physical space becomes an environment that adapts to the people in it.

“Until now, we have shown XR that many people can enjoy together without wearing any device. SPACEON is the stage where the space itself understands people and responds,” said Haehyun Jung, CEO of NEWJAK. “We hope it becomes the starting point for a shift from XR where people adapt to devices to XR where the space adapts to people.”

Reading 15 People at Once and Responding in Under 0.05 Seconds: “Not a Piece of Content, but the Platform That Content Runs On”

SPACEON is an Autonomous Spatial Intelligence Platform that NEWJAK developed in 2026. It operates through five AI functions: SENSE, MODEL, ADAPT, SYNC, and LEARN. The platform tracks multiple users simultaneously without markers and analyzes their movement and engagement in real time to build a behavior model for each person.

The analysis is immediately reflected in the content. According to NEWJAK, when the system detects a child with slower reaction times and a shorter reach, it automatically enlarges targets by 35%, reduces the interaction range by 25%, and slows the game speed by 20%. Users sharing the same space are each given their own role and goals.

NEWJAK’s stated performance figures are simultaneous recognition of up to 15 people, a 50-square-meter tracking area, positional accuracy of ±3 cm, AI inference in 30 ms, and total sensing-to-response latency of 48.2 ms. A LiDAR sensor array handles full-body tracking, and rendering runs on an Unreal Engine 5 pipeline. As operating data accumulates, the platform continues to optimize how the space is run.

NEWJAK stresses that SPACEON is a foundation platform rather than a single piece of content. Media art, retail showrooms, the autonomous experience room META-ROOM, SPORTRACK, X-RUNNER, and a training drone simulator all run on one AI platform. The same space and equipment can host educational content in the morning and games or exhibitions in the afternoon.

Built on Five National R&D Projects and Patents in Three Countries: “We Will Expand Partnership and Distribution Talks in North America and Europe” The technology was built up through national research and development. NEWJAK is carrying out five government-funded projects, including the Ministry of SMEs and Startups’ Super-Gap Startup project, the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA)’s R&D and talent development programs, and a global cooperative R&D program of the Korea Technology and Information Promotion Agency for SMEs (TIPA). The company holds registered patents in the United States, Japan, and China, has received a decision to grant in Europe, and has filed an international (PCT) patent application for SPACEON.

The technology has also been proven in the field. NEWJAK’s spatial XR systems are installed in defense, education, and public facilities in Korea, including the Korea Army Training Center, Jihyo Elementary School in Goyang, the Chuncheon Idea Library, and the Hanam Mental Health Welfare Center. In 2024, the company ran a device-free XR program at 20 middle schools in Incheon.

Overseas activity is accelerating as well. In October, NEWJAK received the Smart Glasses Core Technology Innovation Award of the Year for SPORTRACK at the Shenzhen International AI+AR Smart Glasses Industry Expo 2026 in China. The company also signed a memorandum of understanding with UAE-based MetaLife Metaverse to cooperate in the Middle East market.

“This result means even more because everyone on the team, from planning and design to development and our interns, built it together,” Jung said. “Because a single platform can run many kinds of content, we will expand partnership and distribution discussions with partners in North America and Europe who operate spaces in education, exhibitions, and retail.”

CES 2027 takes place January 6-9, 2027, in Las Vegas. NEWJAK will exhibit SPACEON at booth 50765 in Venetian Expo, Halls A-D, as part of the Jeonnam-Gwangju Special Metropolitan City pavilion.

NEWJAK Co., Ltd. is a spatial XR company that turns the space itself into the screen, with no headset required. Combining projection mapping with AI vision technology, it transforms festival, exhibition, education, and cultural venues into interactive content. Founded in March 2016 as a media facade producer, the company has since expanded into developing its own XR platforms. The name NEWJAK joins the English word “new” with the Korean word “jak,” meaning “to create.”
